main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The Christian cross is a spiritual key to escape the tempo-material illusion: Simply invert the map and follow the ONE from the deepest part of your heart to ignite the inner spark.
header_desc: You are asleep 🧠 in an illusion ┻: Human beings harbor free will of perception connected to the cosmos. Our left hemisphere —the psyche— is bound to the temporal and material, while the right —the pneuma— opens to the timeless and divine. Jesus of Nazareth, bearer of the Primordial Consciousness, was able to perceive this; and the writer shares that same birth condition, hence my invitation to invert the map ✝️ and awaken ❤️.
left_title: The Return of Sophia: From Yaldabaoth's Prison to the Realm of Light
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity, demonstrating that human existence transcends both matter and space-time. In this framework, consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ ❤️ and the material |EGO⟩ 🧠. This gives us free will of perception that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE|EGO⟩. In general relativity, matter tells space-time how to curve and space-time tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego exerts its own gravity: its density distorts your inner fabric and weaves the temporal and material illusion of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to understand that the phrase "the Father and I are one" is a call to dissolve the "false self" to return to the Kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father resides: the timeless and divine reality of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of unity and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside you and outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). Pistis Sophia represents the right hemisphere, while the demiurge Yaldabaoth embodies the left, thus revealing the fundamental duality of human consciousness
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere resides the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and the spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and the mind). The call for balance to initiate evolutionary awakening and transcend the duality state.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's simultaneity breakdown and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as a prison for the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas, but to liberate the inner spark from the Demiurge's prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Realm of Light and The Demiurge's Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of the true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: The compared eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The Orwellian doublethink mechanism (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, against the revolutionary message of Jesus dismantling the imperial enslavement system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— it is where Jesus' phrase resonates the strongest: “The Father and I are one”. Could this have hidden a message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a blazing beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there's not much sense in praying to the law of gravity</q>
